title: HSK 3.2 · 其实, 决定, 解决, 现实, 表演
focus: 内 · 每 · 美 · 一切 · 由 · 任何 · 决定 · 如何 · 其实 · 表现 · 解决 · 美元 · 处理 · 管 · 城市 · 终于 · 现场 · 代表 · 里面 · 确定 · 任务 · 容易 · 确实 · 负责 · 交易 · 理解 · 城 · 责任 · 事件 · 由于 · 属于 · 事实 · 表演 · 规定 · 市场 · 管理 · 实际上 · 现实 · 内容 · 上面
body:
A lesson of "real" and "fixed" words: 实 (real) shows up five times, 定 (fix, settle) three times, and 理 (reason, put in order) three times.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 实 | shí | real, solid | 其实, 确实, 事实, 实际上, 现实 |
| 表 | biǎo | show, outside | 表现, 代表, 表演 |
| 现 | xiàn | appear, present | 表现, 现场, 现实 |
| 定 | dìng | fix, settle | 决定, 确定, 规定 |
| 理 | lǐ | reason; put in order | 处理, 理解, 管理 |
| 任 | rèn | duty; let, allow | 任何, 任务, 责任 |
| 于 | yú | at, to, from | 终于, 由于, 属于 |
| 确 | què | firm, true | 确定, 确实 |

## Watch out

- 由 yóu vs 田 tián vs 甲 jiǎ vs 申 shēn: where the vertical stroke pokes out.
- 处 is chǔ "handle" in 处理 but chù "place" in 到处.
- 负责 (bear + duty) and 责任 (duty + bear) are mirror words.

cards.Example: 三天内完成。 sān tiān nèi wánchéng: finish within three days
cards.Notes: 冂 border + 人 entering = going in → inside. Compare 肉 ròu meat, which has two 人.

cards.Example: 我每天跑步。 wǒ měitiān pǎobù: I run every day
cards.Notes: 𠂉 on top + 母 mǔ below (sound hint). 母 has two dots inside. Also the sound part of 海 and 梅.

cards.Example: 这里真美！ zhèlǐ zhēn měi: it's so beautiful here!
cards.Notes: Traditionally read as 羊 sheep (on top) + 大 big = a big fine sheep → beautiful. 美国 = beautiful country = USA.

cards.Example: 一切都好。 yíqiè dōu hǎo: everything's fine
cards.Notes: 一 one + 切 all = all of it → everything. 切 is qiè here but qiē "cut" on its own. 一 is said yí before qiè.

cards.Example: 这件事由我负责。 zhè jiàn shì yóu wǒ fùzé: I'm in charge of this
cards.Notes: 田 with the vertical poking out the top. Lookalikes: 田 tián, 由 yóu, 甲 jiǎ, 申 shēn.

cards.Example: 我没有任何问题。 wǒ méiyǒu rènhé wèntí: I have no questions at all
cards.Notes: 任 let, allow (亻 + 壬 rén for the sound) + 何 what = whatever you like → any.

cards.Example: 我决定去了。 wǒ juédìng qù le: I've decided to go
cards.Notes: 决 decide (冫 + 夬 for the sound) + 定 fix, settle = settle on → decide.

cards.Example: 你觉得如何？ nǐ juéde rúhé: what do you think?
cards.Notes: 如 like, as + 何 what = like what → how. A written, formal 怎么.

cards.Example: 其实我不饿。 qíshí wǒ bú è: actually I'm not hungry
cards.Notes: 其 its, that + 实 real = its reality → actually.

cards.Example: 他今天表现很好。 tā jīntiān biǎoxiàn hěn hǎo: he did well today
cards.Notes: 表 outside, show + 现 appear = show outwardly → display, how one performs.

cards.Example: 问题解决了。 wèntí jiějué le: the problem is solved
cards.Notes: 解 untie (角 horn + 刀 knife + 牛 ox: cutting up an ox) + 决 decide = untie and settle → solve.

cards.Example: 这个十美元。 zhège shí Měiyuán: this is ten dollars
cards.Notes: 美 America (美国) + 元 yuan, unit of money = American dollar.

cards.Example: 我来处理。 wǒ lái chǔlǐ: I'll handle it
cards.Notes: 处 chǔ deal with + 理 put in order = handle. 处 is chù "place" in 到处, 好处.

cards.Meaning: to manage; to care about; tube
cards.Example: 别管我。 bié guǎn wǒ: leave me alone
cards.Notes: ⺮ bamboo + 官 guān for the sound = bamboo tube; also to control, manage, mind.

cards.Example: 我喜欢这个城市。 wǒ xǐhuan zhège chéngshì: I like this city
cards.Notes: 城 city wall + 市 market = walled market town → city.

cards.Example: 你终于来了！ nǐ zhōngyú lái le: you're finally here!
cards.Notes: 终 end (纟 silk + 冬 dōng for the sound) + 于 at = at the end → finally.

cards.Example: 他在现场。 tā zài xiànchǎng: he's at the scene
cards.Notes: 现 present, now + 场 site, field = the site right now → the scene; live (现场直播).

cards.Example: 我代表公司来。 wǒ dàibiǎo gōngsī lái: I'm here for the company
cards.Notes: 代 act for, replace + 表 show = stand in and show → represent.

cards.Example: 里面有人吗？ lǐmiàn yǒu rén ma: is anyone inside?
cards.Notes: 里 inside + 面 side, face = the inner side. Often said lǐmian.

cards.Example: 你确定吗？ nǐ quèdìng ma: are you sure?
cards.Notes: 确 firm, true (石 stone + 角) + 定 fix = fixed firmly → certain.

cards.Example: 这是你的任务。 zhè shì nǐ de rènwu: this is your task
cards.Notes: 任 duty, appoint + 务 affair, work = assigned work → task.

cards.Example: 这个很容易。 zhège hěn róngyì: this is easy
cards.Notes: 容 contain, allow + 易 easy, change = easy. Also "prone to": 容易生病.

cards.Example: 他确实很忙。 tā quèshí hěn máng: he really is busy
cards.Notes: 确 firm, true + 实 real = truly real → indeed.

cards.Example: 谁负责这个？ shéi fùzé zhège: who's in charge of this?
cards.Notes: 负 bear, carry (⺈ + 贝) + 责 duty = bear the duty → be responsible. Mirror of 责任.

cards.Example: 我们做个交易。 wǒmen zuò ge jiāoyì: let's make a deal
cards.Notes: 交 exchange + 易 change hands = exchange → trade.

cards.Example: 我理解你。 wǒ lǐjiě nǐ: I understand you
cards.Notes: 理 reason, logic + 解 untie, explain = untie the logic → understand.

cards.Example: 我住在城里。 wǒ zhù zài chéng lǐ: I live in town
cards.Notes: 土 earth + 成 chéng for the sound = earthen wall → city wall, city.

cards.Example: 这是我的责任。 zhè shì wǒ de zérèn: this is my responsibility
cards.Notes: 责 duty, blame + 任 post, burden = the duty you bear → responsibility.

cards.Example: 这个事件很严重。 zhège shìjiàn hěn yánzhòng: this incident is serious
cards.Notes: 事 matter + 件 item = an item of matter → incident.

cards.Example: 由于下雨，比赛取消了。 yóuyú xià yǔ, bǐsài qǔxiāo le: the match was cancelled due to rain
cards.Notes: 由 from + 于 at = arising from → due to. A formal 因为.

cards.Example: 这本书属于我。 zhè běn shū shǔyú wǒ: this book belongs to me
cards.Notes: 属 belong to, be of a category + 于 to = belong to. Same 属 as 你属什么 (your zodiac sign).

cards.Example: 这是事实。 zhè shì shìshí: that's a fact
cards.Notes: 事 matter + 实 real = a real matter → fact.

cards.Example: 表演很精彩。 biǎoyǎn hěn jīngcǎi: the show was great
cards.Notes: 表 show + 演 act = show by acting → perform.

cards.Example: 这是公司的规定。 zhè shì gōngsī de guīdìng: it's company rules
cards.Notes: 规 rule, compass (夫 + 见) + 定 fix = a fixed rule.

cards.Example: 我去市场买菜。 wǒ qù shìchǎng mǎi cài: I'm going to the market
cards.Notes: 市 market + 场 open ground = marketplace.

cards.Example: 他管理一家公司。 tā guǎnlǐ yì jiā gōngsī: he manages a company
cards.Notes: 管 control + 理 put in order = manage.

cards.Example: 实际上他是对的。 shíjìshàng tā shì duì de: actually he's right
cards.Notes: 实际 reality (实 real + 际 border, between) + 上 on = on the side of reality → in fact.

cards.Example: 这就是现实。 zhè jiù shì xiànshí: that's reality
cards.Notes: 现 present, visible + 实 real = what's actually present → reality.

cards.Example: 这本书的内容很好。 zhè běn shū de nèiróng hěn hǎo: this book has good content
cards.Notes: 内 inside + 容 contain = what's contained inside → content.

cards.Example: 书在桌子上面。 shū zài zhuōzi shàngmiàn: the book's on the table
cards.Notes: 上 up + 面 side, surface = the top side. Often said shàngmian.
